summary: Set 013 (006's P5, CLI Input Robustness) COMPLETE — 2/2 sessions, set closed. Session 2 delivered the four remaining P5 items plus a verifier-found Major. O-1-4: lifted the seven copy-pasted ParseOptions bodies (Program.cs shared by 6 subcommands + 6 command classes) to one shared AccessHarvester.Cli.OptionParser that rejects positional args, unknown --switches, AND repeated options (the last added after R1 verification); every subcommand now rejects unknown switches uniformly with each command's exact accepted-option set preserved. O-1-7: a single Commands dictionary feeds both the dispatch switch and the bare-file-mode exclusion, removing the hand-sync drift. F-1-5: new AceConnectionString.Build via OleDbConnectionStringBuilder adopted at all FOUR identical OLE DB sites (re-grounding found four, not the two the spec named — 008-012 added sites) so a ';'/quote-bearing database path is quoted correctly instead of misreported as 'ACE provider missing'. F-1-6 (the one fix that can change shipped output): bracket-aware PARAMETERS tokenisation — the clause terminator ';' and entry separator ',' are now honoured only at bracket depth 0, so DAO-legal names like [Enter start date, please] / [Pick one; carefully] no longer shred or truncate. PROVEN GOLDEN-NEUTRAL byte-level: CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests reproduced the committed HHC golden without regen (HHC's PARAMETERS names carry no name-internal ','/';'). DW-15 recorded: identify-cleanup returns exit 2 (not the contract's 1) for usage errors by its own pre-existing inverted convention — preserved (out of P5 scope; exit-code-preserving for that command), pinned. VALIDATION: hermetic AccessHarvester.Tests 691/0; black-box Integration 15/15; COM tier 10/10. VERIFICATION: routed cross-provider gpt-5-4 — R1 ISSUES_FOUND (1 Major: shared parser silently overwrote repeated options) -> fixed -> R2 VERIFIED.
